scope: http://localhost:8080/jahia/administration/osgi-configurations-manager (Jahia 8.2, Chromium headless, axe-core 4.x tags wcag2a/aa, wcag21a/aa, wcag22aa)
15 UI states: initial, .cfg visual editor, filter, add-property prompt, review diff, discard, raw editor, delete/disable confirmations, create dialog (3 tabs), .yml raw editor
Behaviour: Tab order, focus visibility, dialog focus in/return, Monaco Tab capture, Enter on list rows, widths 1280/1024/320, WCAG 1.4.12 text-spacing override

findings.summary: With the Jahia admin navigation open the module needs ~1420 CSS px: at 1280 px Save and the mode selector are cut off; at 1024 px (125% zoom) Save, Cancel, Delete and the Value column are unreachable.
findings.fix: Let the two panes shrink and wrap: replace the fixed 350px sidebar with flex: '0 1 350px' + minWidth: 0, allow the file header/toolbar rows to wrap (flexWrap: 'wrap'), and stack sidebar over editor below ~900px of available width; give the editor pane overflow: auto rather than hidden so nothing becomes unreachable.
findings.evidence: 1280x800: save-config-button right=1280 (clipped), editor-mode-dropdown clipped; 1024x800: cancel right=1124, delete right=1080, save right=1280, document scrollWidth=1419; screenshot 40-width-1024.png

findings.summary: At 320 CSS px (1280 at 400%) the module needs about 1100 px of horizontal scrolling even with the secondary navigation collapsed (h1 975px wide), and with it open the module is not visible at all.
findings.fix: Same layout change as RT-REFLOW-CLIP for the module; the shell's navigation covering the viewport is Jahia's and should be reported to the platform team.
findings.evidence: 320x256, secondary nav collapsed: document scrollWidth=1119, module h1 width=975

findings.summary: In the raw editor Tab and Shift+Tab stay in the editor; the only way out on macOS is Ctrl+Shift+M, which nothing tells the user, and Alt+F1 opens no help in this build.
findings.fix: Show a persistent hint in the raw editor toolbar ('Ctrl+M / Ctrl+Shift+M on macOS: Tab moves focus') and/or a toolbar toggle calling editor.trigger('keyboard','editor.action.toggleTabFocusMode'); set ariaLabel including that hint.
findings.evidence: Tab x3 from the editor textarea: focus stays on TEXTAREA 'Editor content'; Ctrl+M has no effect on macOS; Ctrl+Shift+M then Tab leaves; Alt+F1 shows no widget

findings.summary: Each of the 77 file rows is a Tab stop, but Enter (and Space) on a focused row does not open the file; only the Arrow keys on the list container or a mouse click do.
findings.fix: Make each entry a native <button> (or a listbox option driven by the container), and set tabIndex={-1} on the Moonstone TableRow so the list is one Tab stop.
findings.evidence: focus file-row-aaaa2.cfg, press Enter: selected file stays aaaa.cfg; Tab sequence from the h1 hits 6 controls then 77 TR rows

findings.summary: The file list container takes focus (6th Tab stop) with outline-style none and no other indicator; the screenshot of the focused list shows no ring.
findings.fix: Remove outline: 'none' and add a :focus-visible outline of at least 2px with 3:1 contrast, or move focus semantics to the rows.
findings.evidence: activeElement DIV (list) computed outline-style none, box-shadow none; screenshot 20-list-focus.png

findings.summary: The focus ring on Moonstone buttons, search fields and switch is a 2px #63d1ff outline, about 1.7:1 against the white panels, so focus is hard to see.
findings.fix: Override the focus ring inside the module (e.g. .osgi-config-manager :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent_dark) }, #0072b1 = 5.2:1) and report the token to the Moonstone team.
findings.evidence: computed outline on New/Import/Refresh/Cancel: solid 2px rgb(99, 209, 255); focus-search.png, focus-switch.png

findings.summary: axe 'label' fails on every per-row encryption checkbox (11 in the sample file) and on the 'Search in content' switch: inputs with no accessible name.
findings.fix: aria-label on each Checkbox naming the property ('Encrypt value of {{key}}'); associate the switch with its visible text via id/htmlFor or aria-labelledby.

findings.summary: axe measured text below 4.5:1 in module content: Create-dialog descriptions #d3d4d5 on #fdfdfd (1.45:1), file path, empty-state heading and filter count #7f8386 (3.82:1), diff dialog Save white on #00a0e3 (2.94:1).
findings.fix: Replace the alpha grey tokens (gray_dark20/40/60) with an opaque colour of at least 4.5:1 (e.g. var(--color-gray_dark)) and drop the inline #00a0e3 Save background.

findings.summary: Moonstone colours used by the module fail 4.5:1: selected file row (2.89:1), Delete button (3.68:1), outlined Add Property (2.94:1), Create-dialog tabs (2.89 and 3.95:1).
findings.fix: Override these within the module (darker accent #0072b1 for the selected row and outlined buttons, #c62828 for danger) and raise a Moonstone token issue.

findings.summary: axe 'scrollable-region-focusable' fails on the review diff body and on the Create dialog's factory list (max-height 220px): scrollable, nothing focusable inside.
findings.fix: tabIndex={0}, role="region" and an aria-label on both scroll containers, with a visible focus style.
findings.evidence: 05-cfg-diff-modal: div max-height 60vh overflow-y auto; 13-create-factory-tab: div max-height 220px overflow auto

findings.summary: The delete confirmation (all Moonstone ModalDialogs) is aria-labelledby itself, so its name is its whole content; it has no aria-describedby, opens on the X button named 'Cancel', and its buttons read 'Cancel', 'CANCEL', 'OK'.
findings.fix: Pass aria-labelledby pointing at the title only and aria-describedby at the message, use role=alertdialog for confirmations, label the X 'Close' and the confirm button with the action ('Delete').
findings.evidence: role=dialog, aria-labelledby === own id, describedby=null, buttons ['Cancel','CANCEL','OK'], initial focus on X

findings.summary: Closing the Add Property prompt with Escape drops focus to <body> instead of returning it to the Add Property button; the prompt input is named only 'Type here...'.
findings.fix: Return focus to the trigger when the prompt closes (it is unmounted-and-remounted, so keep a ref to the trigger), and name the input with the prompt's question.
findings.evidence: activeElement after Escape: BODY; prompt input accessible name from placeholder 'Type here...'

findings.summary: The raw editor's textarea is named 'Editor content' with no file name and no hint about leaving the editor.
findings.fix: ariaLabel: 'Raw content of {{name}}. Ctrl+M (Ctrl+Shift+M on macOS) toggles Tab focus.'

passed: axe target-size (2.5.8): no violation in any of the 15 states
axe: no duplicate-id, button-name, image-alt, list or heading-order violation inside the module
Module h1 'OSGi Configurations Manager' is inside the shell's <main> landmark
Moonstone ModalDialog: focus moves inside on open, background is aria-hidden while open, Escape closes, focus returns to the Delete button
WCAG 1.4.12 text-spacing override (line-height 1.5, letter 0.12em, word 0.16em, paragraph 2em): no clipped text detected on the initial page
Ctrl+Shift+M (macOS) does release Tab from the Monaco editor; no other keyboard trap found
Toolbar buttons (New, Import, Refresh, Cancel, Delete) show a visible focus outline
notes: Out of the module's scope, reported by axe on the Jahia admin shell (platform team): <html> without lang (3.1.1), invalid custom roles on primary nav items (dashboard-menu-item, ...) and accordion headers (accordion-item, aria-expanded/aria-controls invalid), selected tree item white on #00a0e3 (2.89:1), a hidden h1 'Something wrong happened' inside <main>, and the secondary navigation covering the whole viewport at 320 px.
No toast was triggered during the runtime pass (Refresh shows none), so toast announcement relies on the code review finding.
Nothing was saved or deleted on the instance: every dialog was cancelled and every edit discarded.
